name: Rákóczifalva (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of light blue over green, charged at the centre with the town arms of Rákóczifalva (a blue shield with a yellow horseman, with red mantling) above the name RÁKÓCZIFALVA in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
